operator.pipeline: After the existing source photo transform and before encoder. If dataset yields ImageNet-normalized RGB z, compute stateless FP32 zprime_c=(std_perm/std_c)*z_perm+(mean_perm-mean_c)/std_c; identity returns input exactly. This represents raw RGB permutation followed by the unchanged ImageNet normalization. No clipping, grayscale, interpolation, feature fit, pixel/file output, cache or trainable operator.
